title: Pass arguments in order
objective: Know that each value in a call goes to the parameter in the same position, so the order of the values changes the answer.

body.text: The values in a call are matched to the parameters by position. The first value goes to the first takes line, the second value goes to the second takes line, and so on. Swapping two values gives a different answer, so the order is part of the call.

body.title: The order of the values matters
body.code:
function subtract
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left minus right

say subtract 10 and 3
say subtract 3 and 10

body.text: Each parameter needs exactly one value. If a call gives too few values, the compiler stops before the program runs and reports how many values the function needs and how many you gave.

body.prompt: The program prints -7, but the answer should be 7. Make it print 7.
body.starter:
function subtract
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left minus right

say subtract 3 and 10
body.solution:
function subtract
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left minus right

say subtract 10 and 3
